text.title: Sundered Ranks
text.body: Renegade southern legions have entrenched twin flanking camps around a central crag to starve Oakhaven into surrender. Master-at-Arms Toren advises cracking both flanks before breaking the Northern Commander and his hulking War-Golem atop the ridge.
text.obj.2: Defeat the Northern Commander and War-Golem
text.msg.1: Renegade patrols sweep below the crag. Crack both palisade flanks first, then bring armor-sundering steel to shatter that War-Golem's stone core atop the ridge!
text.msg.2: The Western flank encampment breaks in disarray; our vanguard secures the battalion payroll coffer of five hundred crowns!
text.msg.3: The Eastern flank scatters into the pines; recovered from their baggage line is five hundred coins in plundered bullion!
text.msg.4: Both flanks are sundered! The Northern Commander charges down the crest beside his War-Golem!
text.msg.5: The War-Golem's stone core shatters and the Northern Commander falls. The coastal highway is open!
text.win: Both flanking camps and the ridge command are broken; the coastal highway lies open.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell among the sundered ranks.
